text: Scan capture spec live from Mon Nov 9 (NY schedule, DST automatic). One scans doc per pass, id YYYY-MM-DD-<kind>-<HHMM UTC scheduled>, kinds premarket|unusualvol|open|mid|lasthour|close. Passes (NY time): premarket 08:00, 09:00; unusualvol 09:00; open 09:34/09:39/09:44; mid every 30 min 10:00-15:00 (two tasks: on the hour and half past); lasthour 15:15; close/nightly 16:12. Top-level: date, kind, ts_utc, scheduled_utc, late (>10 min), rebuilt, src, method, rows. Rows at scan time: t, co, c, pc (true prev close), ch, o, v, relvol, preHi, preHiAt_utc, preVol, fl, so (null not 0; flNote), ps, psd, f30, f30c (financing/offering/reverse split/Nasdaq notice/13D/13G/insider buy/6-K/other), hl, hlAt_utc, where, tradable, f, lf, sf, setup, n. Nightly fill only: loc, firstSeen_utc (today); d1, h1, l1, h1p, l1p (+1 day); d3; d5; splitAdj/splitNote with d1adj..l1adj on pre-split basis. Minutes docs get pc and firstSeen_utc nightly. Docs before Nov 9 keep legacy ids (YYYY-MM-DD, -premarket, -midHHMM, -catchup, etc.) and are not renamed.
